This fetch has no timeout, abort signal, or error handling for network stalls. If the Salesforce endpoint is slow or unresponsive, it will block the entire connection initialization. Unlike other calendar services in this diff that use refreshOAuthTokens wrapper, Salesforce makes a direct fetch call. This is a real defect - a stalled network request could block operations indefinitely.
